label: <DEL> step of long (L=8-9) sequences starting with c
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (t == L, the step that outputs orig(0)) and only for long sequences: L=9 (87% of mass) or L=8 (13%), never L<=7. Strongly keyed to the first original token: c gives 75% of mass (lift ~40x), and w and v give smaller amounts. Magnitude is highest when the second token is b (the top examples all start "c b ...", and the next output being b has lift 14x); s and d as the second token also raise it. Never fires in the original or copy phases. The predicate gets most of the mass (dev mass recall 0.75) but precision is low (~0.13): most L>=8 c-initial delimiter steps stay below threshold. This looks like a thresholded conjunction of first token, second token and length, so it is only partly captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=c (+6.61), orig2=b (+3.42), phase=1 & out_tok=w (+3.40), phase=1 & out_tok=v (+3.10), L=9 & recall_idx=0 (+2.65), orig2=s (+2.51). Lower it: orig7=- (-4.80), in_first=0 (-2.71), prev_tok=i (-2.22), orig2=o (-1.90).
